sanskrit:
किं कर्म किमकर्मेति कवयोऽप्यत्र मोहिताः ।
तत्ते कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात् ॥ ४-१६॥
iast:
kiṃ karma kimakarmeti kavayo’pyatra mohitāḥ
tatte karma pravakṣyāmi yajjñātvā mokṣyase’śubhāt 4-16
translation: What is action? What is inaction? As to this even the wise are deluded. Therefore I shall teach you action (the nature of action and inaction) knowing which you shall be liberated from the evil (of SAMSARA — the wheel of birth and death) .
